## Checklist

- [ ] CI is green (`./gradlew build` — compiles, tests, both shaded jars)
- [ ] Tests cover the change (public interfaces, no skipped or "sleeping" tests)
- [ ] Docs updated in the same PR if public behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, credentials or private data anywhere in the diff
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] User-facing text (messages, docs, config comments) is in English
